Scale any recipe up or down: enter servings and ingredients, get rescaled amounts with metric equivalents.

Enter servings and at least one ingredient.

Seasonings, leavening and cooking time do not scale perfectly — adjust to taste.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the original servings and how many servings you want.
  2. Add each ingredient: amount, unit and name (up to 8).
  3. Read the scaled amounts, each with a metric equivalent.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Do spices scale linearly?

Mostly, but strong spices, salt, leavening and alcohol are best scaled to taste — start with 75% of the scaled amount and adjust.

What about cooking time and temperature?

Temperature stays the same. Time changes with pan size and thickness, not servings — check for doneness, not the clock.

How are amounts rounded?

To two decimals for readability. For cups and spoons, round to the nearest practical measure (¼, ⅓, ½) when cooking.
